queries: SELECT p.staff_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total_amount, SUM(p.amount) / SUM(SUM(p.amount)) OVER () AS fraction_of_total FROM payment AS p WHERE p.rental_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.staff_id ORDER BY p.staff_id

SELECT r.staff_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total_amount, SUM(p.amount) / SUM(SUM(p.amount)) OVER () AS fraction_of_total FROM payment AS p JOIN rental AS r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id GROUP BY r.staff_id ORDER BY r.staff_id
